ordering: Diagnostics are sorted by JSON Pointer path (numeric segments numerically), then by code.

severities.error: The document is invalid. The resolution API answers 422 and no draft is created.
severities.warning: The document is valid. The resolution API answers 200 and includes the warning.

guards: document.object, document.nesting and document.size run first and alone; when one fires it is the only diagnostic.
schemaField: schema: true means the JSON Schema at /api/v1/schemas/lesson/v1 also rejects a document that triggers this code. schema: false means only the resolver and the downloadable validator catch it.

diagnostics.meaning: The request body is not a JSON object.
diagnostics.fix: Send one lesson document as a JSON object, not an array, string, number, null or boolean.

diagnostics.meaning: The document nests deeper than 32 levels.
diagnostics.fix: A lesson needs at most six levels. Remove the deeply nested value; it is not part of the contract.

diagnostics.meaning: The serialized document is over 1,000,000 bytes.
diagnostics.fix: Shorten capturedText excerpts or split the material into more than one lesson.

diagnostics.meaning: The document does not declare schema lesson/v1.
diagnostics.fix: Set "schema": "lesson/v1" at the top level.

diagnostics.meaning: title is missing or blank.
diagnostics.fix: Give the lesson a title.

diagnostics.meaning: assumedKnowledge is missing or blank.
diagnostics.fix: State in one sentence what the learner already knows.

diagnostics.meaning: concepts is missing or empty.
diagnostics.fix: Add at least one Concept.

diagnostics.meaning: sources is missing or empty.
diagnostics.fix: Add at least one structured source with type, title and locator.

diagnostics.meaning: The Concept ID is not a UUIDv4 or repeats another Concept's ID.
diagnostics.fix: Generate a fresh UUIDv4 for each Concept.

diagnostics.meaning: The Concept title is missing or blank.
diagnostics.fix: Give the Concept a title.

diagnostics.meaning: statement is present but not a non-empty string.
diagnostics.fix: Write the statement as one sentence, or remove the field.

diagnostics.meaning: The poolId is not a UUIDv4 or repeats another Concept's poolId.
diagnostics.fix: Generate a fresh UUIDv4 for each Concept's Pool.

diagnostics.meaning: The Concept does not own exactly three options.
diagnostics.fix: Write exactly three options shared by every MCQ in the Concept.

diagnostics.meaning: The option ID repeats another option's ID in the Concept.
diagnostics.fix: Use a short unique slug such as reuse or revalidate.

diagnostics.meaning: The option ID is missing, does not match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$, or is __proto__, constructor or prototype.
diagnostics.fix: Use a short unique slug such as reuse or revalidate.

diagnostics.meaning: The option text is missing or blank.
diagnostics.fix: Write the option as the learner reads it.

diagnostics.meaning: The longest option is more than 1.35 times the length of the shortest, so length signals the key.
diagnostics.fix: Lengthen the short options or shorten the long one until the ratio is at most 1.35.

diagnostics.meaning: The Concept has fewer than two Cards.
diagnostics.fix: Split the idea into at least two Cards. Each Card teaches one idea.

diagnostics.meaning: The Card ID is not a UUIDv4 or repeats another Card's ID anywhere in the lesson.
diagnostics.fix: Generate a fresh UUIDv4 for each Card.

diagnostics.meaning: The Card heading is missing or blank.
diagnostics.fix: Give the Card a heading that states its one idea.

diagnostics.meaning: body is not a non-empty array of paragraph strings.
diagnostics.fix: Write body as an array of paragraphs, one string each.

diagnostics.meaning: The Card is under 120 or over 200 words after inline HTML tags are stripped.
diagnostics.fix: Write 120 to 200 words across the Card's paragraphs.

diagnostics.meaning: The Card has one paragraph, so the clamped corrective view has nothing to expand.
diagnostics.fix: Split the Card into at least two paragraphs. The first is shown after a wrong answer.

diagnostics.meaning: The misconception ID repeats another misconception's ID in the Concept.
diagnostics.fix: Use a short unique slug that names the belief, such as fresh_means_newest.

diagnostics.meaning: The misconception ID is missing, does not match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$, or is a reserved name.
diagnostics.fix: Use a short unique slug that names the belief, such as fresh_means_newest.

diagnostics.meaning: The statement is missing or blank.
diagnostics.fix: Write the belief itself, as the learner would hold it.

diagnostics.meaning: correctingCardId is not the ID of a Card in the same Concept.
diagnostics.fix: Name a Card of this Concept that corrects the belief.

diagnostics.meaning: No MCQ distractor in the Concept maps to this misconception.
diagnostics.fix: Map a distractor to it, or remove the misconception.

diagnostics.meaning: The Question ID is not a UUIDv4 or repeats another Question's ID.
diagnostics.fix: Generate a fresh UUIDv4 for each Question.

diagnostics.meaning: conceptId is not the ID of a Concept in this lesson.
diagnostics.fix: Set conceptId to the id of the Concept the Question checks.

diagnostics.meaning: poolId is not the poolId of the Question's Concept.
diagnostics.fix: Copy the Concept's poolId onto the Question.

diagnostics.meaning: type is not mcq, numeric or short.
diagnostics.fix: Use one of mcq, numeric or short.

diagnostics.meaning: The stem is missing or blank.
diagnostics.fix: Write the question text.

diagnostics.meaning: The stem contains an unbound reference such as "the above", "the second" or "this approach", so it does not stand alone once the Cards are gone.
diagnostics.fix: Name the thing directly. The stem must make sense with the Cards removed.

diagnostics.meaning: reserved is present but not a boolean.
diagnostics.fix: Set reserved to true or false, or omit it for false.

diagnostics.meaning: correctingCardId is not the ID of a Card in the Question's Concept.
diagnostics.fix: Name the Card of this Concept shown after I don't know or a wrong numeric or short answer.

diagnostics.meaning: A numeric or short Question has no feedback string.
diagnostics.fix: Write one or two sentences shown after any answer.

diagnostics.meaning: key is not one option ID of the Concept's shared option set.
diagnostics.fix: Set key to the id of the correct option in the Concept's options.

diagnostics.meaning: An option of the Concept, possibly the key, has no feedback entry.
diagnostics.fix: Add feedback for every option ID in the Concept's set, including the key.

diagnostics.meaning: feedback has a key that is not an option ID of the Concept.
diagnostics.fix: Remove the entry or correct the option ID.

diagnostics.meaning: A distractor option has no map entry.
diagnostics.fix: Map every non-key option ID to a misconception ID in the Concept.

diagnostics.meaning: The map entry names a misconception ID that is not in the Concept.
diagnostics.fix: Use an id from the Concept's misconceptions, or add the misconception there.

diagnostics.meaning: map has an entry for the key or for an ID that is not an option of the Concept.
diagnostics.fix: Keep only the distractor option IDs in map.

diagnostics.meaning: A numeric Question is marked reserved.
diagnostics.fix: Reserve an MCQ or short Question for the Wrap-up instead; numeric Questions are never reserved.

diagnostics.meaning: answer is not a finite number.
diagnostics.fix: Set answer to a JSON number.

diagnostics.meaning: The answer, written as a number, appears in no Card of the Question's Concept.
diagnostics.fix: Teach the number in a Card of the Concept, or ask about a number the Cards contain.

diagnostics.meaning: tolerance is missing or zero.
diagnostics.fix: Set a positive tolerance from the claim being tested, not from the decimal places.

diagnostics.meaning: tolerance is present but not a non-negative finite number.
diagnostics.fix: Set tolerance to a positive JSON number.

diagnostics.meaning: unit is present but not a string.
diagnostics.fix: Set unit to a short string such as seconds, or omit it.

diagnostics.meaning: A short Question has no canonical answer string.
diagnostics.fix: Set answer to the accepted text. Matching ignores case and surrounding whitespace.

diagnostics.meaning: aliases is present but not an array of non-empty strings.
diagnostics.fix: List other accepted spellings as strings, or omit aliases.

diagnostics.meaning: The key is the longest option in more than one third of the lesson's MCQs, so length signals the answer.
diagnostics.fix: Rewrite options so the key is the longest in at most one third of MCQs, counted across the whole lesson.

diagnostics.meaning: No Question of this Concept's Pool is reserved for the Wrap-up.
diagnostics.fix: Mark at least one MCQ or short Question of the Pool reserved: true.

diagnostics.meaning: The Pool has fewer than three drawable (non-reserved) Questions, so the Check cannot ask once and re-ask twice.
diagnostics.fix: Add drawable Questions to the Pool until it has at least three, plus one reserved.

diagnostics.meaning: The source type is missing or blank.
diagnostics.fix: Name the kind of source, such as specification, documentation, repository, commit or conversation.

diagnostics.meaning: The source title is missing or blank.
diagnostics.fix: Give the source a title.

diagnostics.meaning: The source locator is missing or blank.
diagnostics.fix: Give a URL, path, commit SHA or other way to find the source again.

diagnostics.meaning: capturedText is present but neither a string nor null.
diagnostics.fix: Set capturedText to an excerpt string, null, or omit it.

diagnostics.meaning: provenance is missing, or its status is neither provided nor declined.
diagnostics.fix: Send { "status": "provided", ...five fields } or { "status": "declined" }. Omission is invalid.

diagnostics.meaning: status is provided but client is missing or blank.
diagnostics.fix: Name the agent product, or use unknown.

diagnostics.meaning: status is provided but harness is missing or blank.
diagnostics.fix: Name the runtime the agent ran in, or use unknown.

diagnostics.meaning: status is provided but model is missing or blank.
diagnostics.fix: Give the model identifier, or use unknown.

diagnostics.meaning: status is provided but client_version is missing or blank.
diagnostics.fix: Give the client version, or use unknown.

diagnostics.meaning: status is provided but session_reference is missing or blank.
diagnostics.fix: Give an opaque session reference, or use unknown.
